candidate_structure_reference_approval: Data view only. It is not yet added to the accepted scoring protocol; its folds are not issued.
feature_contract: sequence ID and length, pinned revision, full length <=1022, mean/residue layer identity and exact 1-based cached indices; missing coordinates listed, never imputed.
fold_rule: KNOT-PRESENCE stratified group 5 outer/3 inner; PU leave one positive group outer with every U group assigned once and inner3; other tasks retain protocol dispositions.
group_map: binding_group_id and fold assignments are included in this data release; historical identity graph remains in the source project
pu_contract: biological_target=null and biological_mask=0 for U; observed_learning_label=0 is a separate operational label.
source_data_version: Existing audited local data as pinned by config; no new database records added.
strict_disorder_view: DISORDER-RES uses labels_attempt05 exactly; all unknown positions remain mask=0.

structure_reference_view.conflict_rule: mask a residue when direct curated disorder overlaps an observed PDB residue; preserve all original strict labels in their separate view
structure_reference_view.label_semantics: 1=direct curated disordered residue; 0=direct curated ordered residue or amino-acid-matched residue observed in existing experimental PDB mapping; unknown=NA mask0
structure_reference_view.non_unannotated_direct_mask0: remains unknown regardless of PDB observation
structure_reference_view.pdb_observed_use: only add 0 at unannotated direct-label positions with observed PDB mapping; never infer disorder from a residue lacking coordinates
